overview_description.description:
ProTenders is a very quickly growing B2B platform for the Construction industry, enabling developers, architects, engineers, contractors and suppliers of all sizes and from all over the world to quickly increase their visibility, find new leads and streamline their tendering & bidding activities.

It achieves that be delivering 3 powerful modules that work together:

Rich Company Profiles (a.k.a The LinkedIn of Construction) that enables companies to get found based on their expertise, skills, locations,..., resulting in 8-10x more views than when searching on their names only,

Accurate Construction Intelligence, using crowd-sourced and protenders-researched data, that enables companies to identify the right people to talk to based on ongoing projects,

Secure eTendering that enables developers to streamline their entire bidding process and receive bids online, drastically reducing their overheads and providing them with better data so that they can reduce their project risk.
